reporting_sentence: The legacy All Fields BioSample harvest returned 33,829 rows, which can serve as the full reproducibility baseline for the old strategy.
The current strict filtering has confirmed 612 accepted BioSample rows, which should be preserved as the minimum recall baseline for the next round of strict queries.
The old strategy generated 33,217 non-accepted rows, so rejected-result analysis should be used to reverse-optimize the search parameters.
Among the non-accepted rows, 31,827 are non-Xanthomonas organism records, indicating that the main issue is false positives rather than insufficient manual review.
In 30,707 rows, the prefix and number merely appear separately within the record and do not constitute an exact strain identifier match.
Rejected query terms mainly appear in metadata_text, attributes, identifiers, title, and infraspecies, but matches in these fields do not necessarily prove strain identity.
The 148 target-organism non-accepted rows and 1,242 no-hit rows should be retained as a manual review/rescue pool, rather than being treated directly as accepted records.
